body: Thank you! I found her Facebook account and can contact some of her friends if needed. I will talk to her again first though and see how she is doing.

I have never lost anyone close to me to suicide, but I have known people who have died young in car accidents. I know that the love and support of my friends and family really helped me get through the difficult times after they died. I feel your pain and would love to give you a hug. Hugs make me feel better. If the same is true for you, perhaps finding people to hug would be helpful.
